Tribal Advantages · Phillips Property

Financial advantages that lower your costs.

The tribal structure of the Seminole Energy Campus creates structural cost advantages for private sector clients that no off-reservation data center can match.

§ 0%
Federal Tax Exemption
Tribal enterprises are exempt from Federal taxes. Business entities formed between the tribe and private companies may qualify for partial or full exemption — reducing the effective cost of operations from year one.
§ STATE
State Tax Exemption on Improvements
Tribal trust lands and improvements are exempt from state taxation — significantly reducing or eliminating property tax on data center infrastructure. No competing facility can offer this.
§ SALES
Sales Tax Exemptions
Sales tax exemptions exist for equipment used in operating a tribally owned business. On a 100,000 sq ft data center's equipment load, this is a material capital cost advantage.
§ NMTC
New Market Tax Credits
Available for capital investments on Indian reservations. These credits provide a tax advantage for capital partners investing in the Seminole Energy Campus that is unavailable off-reservation.
§ 20%
Wage Tax Credit
Employers receive a tax credit of up to 20% of wages and health insurance for qualified individuals living on or near the reservation. Data center operations create qualifying employment.
§ 2×
Accelerated Depreciation
Equipment owned by non-tribal partners but located on tribal land qualifies for double depreciation rates — dramatically improving the equity return profile for Sovereign Data Centers and capital partners.
Going Green With Seminole Energy

You don't need a complete
revamp to go green.

Several targeted steps help organizations achieve their green data center goals. Seminole Energy can help you implement each of them — from storage migration to full virtualization.

01
Move Storage to Seminole Green DC
Migrate your storage workloads to the Seminole Green Data Center in Oklahoma. Immediate carbon footprint reduction. Tribal tax structure reduces your cost basis on every rack.
02
Upgrade Legacy Equipment
Legacy equipment degrades and requires more energy over time. Seminole Energy can provision new, energy-efficient infrastructure as part of your migration — improving PUE immediately.
03
Turn Off Dead Servers
Companies often purchase more rack space than needed. Seminole Energy's right-sizing analysis identifies underutilized infrastructure — eliminating energy waste before it becomes cost waste.
04
Server Virtualization
Server virtualization allows a single physical machine to do the work of several — via a software layer that maximizes utilization. Seminole Energy supports virtualization migration.
05
AI-Powered Automation
Innovative AI-driven data center management tools automate energy consumption — reducing power when workloads are light and scaling responsively when demand increases.
06
Green Building Certification
Seminole Energy's campus is designed to support green building certification systems — providing the ratings documentation your clients, regulators, and ESG reporting requirements demand.
Industry Commitments
Atos and HDF Energy announced hydrogen fuel cell data center initiatives in 2021. Microsoft deployed an underwater data center demonstrating radical cooling efficiency gains.
Regulatory Pressure
Significant regulatory pressure on firms to go green — broken into technology standards, pollution standards, and market incentives. Green DC certification is becoming a procurement requirement.

Seebury Inc. Partners with
The Seminole Nation of Oklahoma.

PRESS RELEASE
Seebury Inc. and The Seminole Nation of Oklahoma Partner to Drive Economic Development
McGregor, Texas · July 8, 2024

Seebury Inc., a leading renewable energy and multiservice solutions company, and the Seminole Nation of Oklahoma have entered a partnership to drive economic development, energy sovereignty, and infrastructure investment on Seminole Nation lands. The partnership is facilitated through the Seminole Nation Division of Commerce (SNDOC), a governmental agency and instrumentality of the Seminole Nation of Oklahoma which serves as the official commercial development arm of the tribe.

Seminole Energy · Trading Company Profile

Saving Mother Earth.
Building Tribal Wealth.

Seminole Energy Trading represents an innovative endeavor within the energy sector, focused on harnessing the power of both traditional and renewable energy resources to empower the Seminole Nation economically while promoting environmental sustainability and cultural preservation.

ENERGY TRADING
RECs · Carbon Credits · Fossil Fuels
Assisting tribes in trading Renewable Energy Credits to promote clean energy initiatives. Managing fossil fuel trading. Developing and managing the sale of Carbon Credits.
RENEWABLE PROJECTS
Solar · Wind · H₂ · Biomass · WTE
Solar and wind projects on tribal land. Green and Blue Hydrogen development with offtake sales. Waste-to-Value solutions with agricultural feedstocks and MSW. Natural gas with carbon sequestration.
RESOURCE MANAGEMENT
Assessment · Consultation · Strategy
Analyzing energy resources available on tribal lands and developing strategies for optimal use. Expert consultation on energy projects and policies aligned with tribal sovereignty goals.
Core Values
⬡Sustainability — Committed to practices that respect and protect the environment and tribal lands
⬡Empowerment — Fostering economic growth and self-sufficiency within the Seminole community
⬡Innovation — Integrating modern technology with traditional indigenous knowledge
⬡Collaboration — Building partnerships with tribes, governments, and private sector to maximize benefits
Free Trade Zone Opportunity

Seminole Energy can develop Free Trade Zones in Seminole, Oklahoma — unlocking Foreign-Trade Zone (FTZ) benefits for businesses operating on tribal land:

Defer, reduce, or eliminate customs duties on imported business goods
State and local ad valorem taxes cannot be imposed on imported property in an FTZ
Avoid per-shipment customs processing fees
